info.weakness: Air spells: 30 to 50% elemental weakness.
info.requiredItems: Nose peg or Slayer helmet mandatory (without it they use an always-hitting stat-draining special). Slayer helm covers this.
info.notableDrops: Grimy herbs in bulk (ranarr, snapdragon), ranarr/snapdragon seeds, gem drop table. Superior Abhorrent spectre drops.

locations.label: Abyssal Nexus

info.weakness: Demonbane weapons receive their usual bonuses.

info.weakness: A slash hit severs the lure and lowers its stab Defence by 50; damage is not required for the sever.
